name: Northwoods | Cake Pops
description: This strain inherits the sweet, cake-like scent from Cakelatto, with notes of vanilla, cream, and a hint of citrus while the Biscotti influence adds earthy and nutty undertones. Cake Pops delivers a mouthwatering flavor profile that mirrors its aromatic complexity. The initial inhale reveals a sweet and creamy essence, reminiscent of a decadent dessert. The flavor evolves as earthy and nutty undertones emerge, providing a well-balanced and satisfying experience for the palate.
